item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-24
item.description: MIIT quantifies China's open source ecosystem for the first time: 1.35B OpenHarmony devices, 10B model downloads; Jensen Huang defends Chinese open-source AI; White House specifically accuses Moonshot AI of distilling Fable 5; Arcee says Chinese models not inherently dangerous.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-22
item.description: US Treasury threatens sanctions on Chinese open-source AI models over IP theft; MIT Technology Review analyzes how Chinese AI divides Trump's camp; China explicitly champions open source at UN's first global AI governance dialogue.
